pages.title: Fishing
pages.text: **Aquaculture 2** replaces plain fishing with dozens of fish across the ocean, rivers, swamps and cold waters, and with rods, hooks, bait and lines you can swap.

pages.title: Iron Fishing Rod
pages.text: Rods come in Iron, Golden, Diamond and Neptunium. A better rod tolerates better hooks.

pages.title: Tackle Box
pages.text: Holds hooks, line, bobber and bait in one place. Hooks have effects: Heavy, Light, Double, Redstone, Note, Glowstone, Quartz, Soul Sand, Obsidian and Nether Star.

pages.title: Worm Farm
pages.text: Makes Worms, the standard bait. Fish are caught with bait on the line.

Catches include cod, halibut, herring, salmon, pollock, trout, bass, catfish, piranha, arapaima, tuna, jellyfish and several turtles.

- Plenty come in a bucket, so they can be moved.
- Fillet them with a [Fillet Knife](item://aquaculture:iron_fillet_knife) for meat that cooks well.
- Aquaculture's piranha and jellyfish are its own catches.

pages.title: Neptunium Ingot
pages.text: Rare fishing loot. Neptunium makes tools, armor and a bow, and can be smelted back from them.

pages.title: Neptune's Bounty
pages.text: A box of Neptunium loot, made from Neptunium ingots.

Cooking: Aquaculture Delight and Ocean's Delight turn catches into meals, see [#](2E5AAC)[Sea Food](entry://ocean/sea_food)[#](). Hybrid Aquatic and Naturalist add their own fish, and Hybrid's hooks work for rare ones: see [#](2E5AAC)[Sea Life](entry://ocean/sea_life)[#]().
